name: Topo-Feature Ontology
abstract: Classes and properties for features whose geometry is defined by topological references to other features: the topology types (Edge, Ring, Face, Shell, Solid, AggregateSolid and curve types), plain and oriented references, and the multi-collection groupings. Provides the definitions for the terms bound by the Topo-Feature JSON-LD contexts.

sources.title: Topo-Feature building block descriptions and schemas
